question: Three circles of radius 6 cm are kept touching each other. The string is tightly tied around these three circles. What is the length of the string?
solution:
**Given:**

Three circles of radius 6 cm are kept touching each other.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4975c69029e7a1c7d303fdc50aecc82072a4605039371102d559a105306b89a6.png] 

The length of the string not in contact with the circle = 2r + 2r + 2r

⇒ 6r = 6 × 6

⇒ 36

By symmetry, the angles swiped by the string on one circle is 120.

Length of string touching circle = 2πr/3 + 2πr/3 + 2πr/3

⇒ 6πr/3

⇒ 2πr = 2 × 6 × π

⇒ 12π

Total length = 36 + 12π

**∴ The required answer is 36 + 12**π** cm.**
